mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_department WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE

WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS ( SELECT * FROM sys_department WHERE parent_id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE UNION SELECT d.* FROM sys_department d JOIN subtree s ON d.parent_id=s.id WHERE d.deleted=FALSE ) SELECT * FROM subtree ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_department WHERE parent_id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE department_id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_department SET parent_id=#{department.parentId}, code=#{department.code}, name=#{department.name}, sort_order=#{department.sortOrder}, status=#{department.status}, deleted=#{department.deleted}, version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{department.updatedBy} WHERE id=#{department.id} AND version=#{department.version} AND deleted=FALSE
